Cboe files for first US 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ether ETFs –
Link
Cboe BZX Exchange submitted an SEC filing on August 14 (dated August 10) to list 3x daily leveraged BTC and ETH ETFs, sponsored by Volatility Shares, alongside similar leveraged commodity funds.
• If approved, the products would add a higher-risk, higher-leverage way to trade BTC/ETH exposure in the US.
• The filing is not yet approved and will go through a public comment period.
Matters because: Leveraged BTC and ETH ETFs could amplify volatility around expiry and rebalancing periods once live.

SEC postpones "regulation crypto" rule-making meeting, citing scheduling issues –
Link
The SEC canceled its Aug. 15 meeting to propose "Regulation Crypto," the first major crypto securities exemption framework, with no new date set. The related tokenized-stock "innovation exemption" was also delayed again amid Wall Street and White House pushback.
Matters because: This stalls two major 2026 regulatory catalysts and keeps near-term uncertainty elevated for US-listed tokenization plays.

Bitcoin spot ETFs post continued net outflows, BTC trades below $64K –
Link
US spot BTC ETFs saw a small net outflow of -$0.7M on August 14, following a much larger -$131.1M outflow on August 13, led largely by Fidelity redemptions. BTC is trading around $63,000–63,700, down roughly 1.4% on the day.
Matters because: Persistent ETF outflows alongside a soft BTC price suggest institutional demand has cooled short-term and could keep pressure on BTC if the trend continues.
